_comment: Tracked recurring issues found by the weekly calibration agent. Each issue has: id, theme (or category, or null for global), first_observed (run_id), last_observed (run_id), status (open|monitoring|resolved), description, evidence_runs (list of run_ids), actions_taken (list of {run_date, action}), recommendation_pending (bool, true if the fix requires a human edit to a forbidden/prompt-level field).

issues.description: Catastrophic theme score collapse affecting weekday themes (Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday) starting July 26, persisting through August 2 (10 consecutive runs). Mean theme scores: Monday 26.6→7.1→8.0 (stable pre-collapse, now collapsed), Tuesday 26.6→3.0→3.1 (dead), Wednesday 26.6→8.4→8.9 (weak recovery), Thursday 26.6→4.2→4.6 (dead). Weekend themes unaffected (Friday 37.4, Saturday 39.1, Sunday 48.7 as of Aug 2). Composite histograms show near-total 0-19 concentration for collapsed themes (e.g., Tuesday Aug 2: 1762/1773 articles in 0-19 band). This is a scoring_prompt regression, not upstream content shift—the collapse was immediate, not gradual, and weekend themes prove the pipeline can still generate healthy scores. Podcast feeds for collapsed themes are critically thin (Monday 4–36 articles vs target 100, Tuesday 1–25 articles), while weekend holdover banks overflow (1400+ banked for Friday/Saturday/Sunday vs 85–462 for weekdays). Root cause is almost certainly a scoring_prompt or theme_description change that broke weekday theme matching around July 26.

actions_taken.action: None—this requires human review of scoring_prompt and theme_description fields for Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday, which are in the forbidden auto-edit list. No auto-tunable knob (min_score, holdover_threshold, keyword additions) will fix a near-zero mean_theme_score caused by a scoring failure. Flagging as open recurring issue pending human intervention.
